payload.name: add_to_waitlist
payload.description: Put the caller on the waitlist for dates the hotel is SOLD OUT on. Use ONLY after check_room_availability has come back empty for their dates and the caller wants to be told if something opens up. Records their name, number, dates, and party size and returns a reference - it does NOT hold or promise a room; the desk reaches out only if a room frees up. Never use it when rooms ARE available (book those instead) and never imply it guarantees anything.
